description:
MCP server connecting intervals.icu training data to AI assistants.

icuvisor is a local-first Model Context Protocol server that connects intervals.icu training data to AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Pi, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible clients.
### Added

• `add_or_update_event` now accepts optional `color` and `not_on_fitness_chart` fields and returns them in terse calendar event rows when present.
